meta.title: A user whose team has the PR's category is shown

steps.note: Enable the required PR team-category filtering configuration for this case.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the PR manager.
Stay on the Open PR tab where PR-1 is available.
Select one line item from the named PR-1 so the assignment controls become available.

args.goal: On the selected PR-1 line item, click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, inspect the Search a user list, scroll to the end, and stop with the list showing Food Buyer (User A).

steps.note: Perform the buyer-side Assign interaction and inspect the complete filtered assignee list.
Assert that the category-matched Food Buyer user appears in the assignee list.
